messages:
alex: Heads-up — I need to swap out my ARB facilitator slot for Wed (1747005600) due to a client review. Can someone cover? Also proposing we trial an opt-in agenda template to speed triage: short items only, 5m lightning, 20m RFC deep-dive. Link to calendar: https://cal.example.com/arb/wed

nina: I can cover that slot, alex. Can you drop in a short note about which RFCs need the deep-dive?

alex: Awesome, nina — thanks. Primary thing is the new routing policy RFC (PR #412). Also a quick FYI on batching heuristics. Rough agenda I was thinking:
```
- 5m: quick stand + roll call
- 10m: triage (open issues)
- 20m: RFC deep-dive (routing policy)
- 5m: lightning topics (2x 2.5m)
- 10m: action items & next steps
```
If folks want to opt into lightning topics, they can add a one-sentence blurb in the calendar description.

sam: +1 to the opt-in approach. Could we add a small "timekeeper" field to the facilitator checklist so we actually stick to 5m/20m boxes? I can volunteer as timekeeper for Wed.

katie: I have a conflict Wed afternoon — thanks for covering, nina. One ask: can we reserve the first 5 minutes for a short rollout/canary status from eng-runtime? There's a kube upgrade happening and we might want to call out regressions early.

nina: Noted. I'll slot a 2m canary update into the quick stand. Alex — do you want me to post the draft agenda to #eng-platform an hour before the meeting?

alex: Yes please. Also, here's a tiny template for folks to paste if they want a lightning slot:
```
[Lightning] <one-line title> — <2-3 sentence context> — <ask: decision / feedback / FYI>
```
That way the facilitator can triage quickly.

ci-bot: calendar invite updated by nina: https://cal.example.com/arb/wed (facilitator: nina, timekeeper: sam)

sam: I'll ping the list 15 minutes prior to remind people to add lightning topics if they want them.

katie: Thanks team. If anyone wants to swap future facilitator dates, I've posted my availability in the shared rota doc.

alex: Appreciated. Quick follow-up for the facilitator: if the RFC needs more than 20m, call for a follow-up deep-dive RFC session and capture action items — avoid overrunning the main agenda.

nina: Got it. I'll post the agenda now and tag the owners for the RFCs.

alex: :thumbsup:
